Invalid UTF-8 creation returned EILSEQ (92), and a zero-X mkstemp template succeeded instead of returning EINVAL. Both Linux targets passed. darwin_template_source: https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/Libc/blob/71bbe350ab79eef58113991d817ccc6165061a64/stdio/FreeBSD/mktemp.c — find_temp_path randomizes trailing Xs but does not require any; mkstemp and mkdtemp both call it. Empty templates are rejected before the action. This supports the observed zero-X result and the corrected empty-template error fixture.
corrected_local_validation: All six temporary-path fixtures passed against unchanged production on Linux (/tmp/martensite-temporary-platform-baseline.log). Corrected full-gate and native results remain pending; #140 is not yet closed.
existing_capabilities: Existing rustix 1.1.5 has no mkstemp/mkdtemp wrapper in its source. The existing tempfile dependency uses OpenOptions and its own name generation, rather than forwarding the supplied libc template. That is not a demonstrated exact replacement for these interfaces.

candidate.source: Inspected registry source src/unistd.rs: mkstemp at line 2279 and mkdtemp at line 2321.
candidate.behavior: Copies a NUL-terminated template, calls the corresponding libc function once, removes the trailing NUL and returns raw path bytes through PathBuf. mkstemp returns an OwnedFd; into_raw_fd can preserve the toolkit's existing ownership transfer without adding first-party unsafe. Pre-normalizing through c_path is required to preserve first-NUL truncation.
candidate.caution: The separately recorded nix directory-stream issue #126 does not justify using its directory API here; only the two inspected temporary-path wrappers are candidates. Dependency audit and review are still required.
